note: Town of Lumsden campground at 55 Hwy 20, across from the RCMP detachment: fully treed lots inside a bend of an old Qu'Appelle River channel, beside the town's ball diamonds, playground and splash pad, with the Trans Canada Trail on site. Water service runs from the May long weekend to the end of September. --Claude
